title: Liangxuan Technology And SAlS Partner On Quantum Computing For Science
excerpt: Liangxuan Technology and SAlS partner to advance quantum computing for scientific intelligence, signing a cooperation agreement on November 4th.
content:
Shenzhen Liangxuan Technology and the Shanghai Academy of AI for Science formalized a deepened collaboration on November 4th with the signing of the “Quantum Computing Ecosystem Cooperation Agreement” in Shanghai. The partnership will focus on applying quantum computing to areas including scientific research and artificial intelligence, building on production-research cooperation already underway around superconducting quantum cloud computing. “This signing is an important milestone in deepening the collaboration between the two parties,” according to the agreement, which aims to use Liangxuan Technology’s platforms with SAlS’s research capabilities to explore new applications and build an industrial ecosystem.

Liangxuan Technology and SAlS Formalize Quantum Computing Ecosystem Collaboration

Prior to the agreement, Liangxuan Technology had already initiated production-research cooperation with the SAlS quantum technology team, specifically focusing on superconducting quantum cloud computing, establishing a foundation for application verification and collaborative projects. The partnership extends beyond initial research, with both organizations planning to concentrate on fields like scientific intelligence, combinatorial optimization and quantum chemistry, using their unique strengths to accelerate progress, SAlS says. According to the agreement, collaborative efforts will include topic research, concept verification and scenario testing, with a focus on projects demonstrating both scientific and industrial value.

This will involve joint research, co-creation of solutions and the establishment of connections with industrial resources, moving beyond basic research toward practical applications. Both parties will also link research teams and ecosystem partners to facilitate talent training, technical achievement exchange and the co-construction of industrial ecosystems.

The formalized collaboration aims to address the growing need for connection between quantum computing and fields like artificial intelligence and basic scientific research. SAlS, a strategic R&D institution focused on scientific intelligence, has assembled a team of AI scientists, engineers and researchers from diverse fields including material science and life science, all working to advance complex scientific research, according to the company. Liangxuan Technology’s capabilities in quantum computing products, platforms, tools, and technical services will complement SAlS’s strengths in research organization and ecosystem connection.

“Quantum Computing Empowering Scientific Intelligence – Technological Innovation and Ecosystem Collaboration” served as the theme for a symposium held before the signing, where both sides exchanged in-depth opinions on technical capabilities, application scenarios and ecosystem development. Both organizations expressed their intention to establish a consistent communication and docking mechanism, prioritizing concrete project needs to drive the application of quantum computing in both research and industrial settings. The collaboration seeks to build an open platform for joint problem-solving, application verification, and talent exchange, providing important support for a collaborative quantum innovation ecosystem.
